correctness.rationale: Both strong Weihrauch reductions were reconstructed explicitly. The upper reduction uses the decidable finite-prefix homomorphism predicate and identity postprocessing. The lower reduction maps each zero of the input sequence to a vertex carrying every relation diagonal; absence of a common diagonal point is exactly what makes that vertex obstruct every homomorphism. The converse computable branch follows from the constant homomorphism. Exhaustive finite sanity checks passed.
